gorp.name: T04 Derived Unit
gorp.comment:
Unit algebra with the answer written down. Track carries distance in metres and elapsed in seconds; Result carries speed as \metre\second\tothe{-1}, which is what dividing one by the other derives.
The rate is spelled with a NEGATIVE EXPONENT, never with \per: \per grades Silver and would quietly downgrade the whole design, while the exponent form grades Platinum for the same physics. On the surface it reads m/s.
gorp.expect:
Check finds nothing and Run comes back OK.
The output's unit must display as m/s on the chip and as \metre\second\tothe{-1} on hover and in the file.
